title: Syntax test characterizes parseability
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, start a six-state machine in state $0$ and process the bits of $x$ in order, with states numbered $0$ through $5$. On input $1$, the transitions from states $0,1,2,3$ are respectively to $1,2,2,1$; on input $0$, they are respectively to $4,0,3,1$; either input from states $4$ or $5$ leads to state $5$. The syntax test returns true exactly when this process ends in state $4$, which holds exactly when exact-consumption parsing of $x$ succeeds.
